metadata.description: Schema markup, crawlability, JavaScript rendering, Core Web Vitals, web crawler intelligence
metadata.per_source_detail: The per-source detail gathered while building this skill is not redistributed; this list links to the originals.

schema_markup.definition: Structured data code (typically JSON-LD format) that explicitly tells search engines and AI systems what content represents

priority_schemas_for_aeo.aeo_importance: Extremely high - directly feeds featured snippets and AI answers
priority_schemas_for_aeo.implementation: Each Q&A pair defined with mainEntity property

priority_schemas_for_aeo.aeo_importance: Very high - structured steps ideal for AI extraction
priority_schemas_for_aeo.implementation: Define each step with text, image, and optional supply/tool lists

priority_schemas_for_aeo.use_case: Blog posts, news articles, long-form content
priority_schemas_for_aeo.aeo_importance: High - establishes content type and authorship
Medium-high - establishes entity for Knowledge Graph
High - similar to FAQPage for specific Q&A content
priority_schemas_for_aeo.structure: Main question with acceptedAnswer and suggestedAnswer properties

priority_schemas_for_aeo.aeo_importance: Medium - helps AI understand content relationships
priority_schemas_for_aeo.implementation: Define navigation path from homepage to current page

crawlability_fundamentals.definition: The degree to which AI crawlers and search engine bots can access, navigate, and understand website content

critical_factors.purpose: Control which bots can access which parts of site
critical_factors.aeo_best_practice: Allowlist AI bots explicitly to ensure content access

critical_factors.purpose: Provide comprehensive list of site URLs for efficient crawling
best_practices: Include all important pages
Update automatically when new content published
Submit to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools
Use multiple sitemaps for large sites (max 50,000 URLs per sitemap)
Include lastmod dates for content freshness signals

critical_factors.purpose: Help crawlers discover all content and understand relationships
best_practices: All important pages within 3 clicks from homepage
Use descriptive anchor text for internal links
Create topic cluster internal linking (hub to spokes)
Avoid orphaned pages with no internal links
Implement breadcrumb navigation

critical_factors.purpose: Clear, logical URLs aid crawler understanding
best_practices: Use descriptive, keyword-rich URLs
Implement hierarchical structure (domain.com/category/subcategory/page)
Avoid excessive parameters and session IDs
Use hyphens (not underscores) to separate words
Keep URLs concise (under 100 characters when possible)

javascript_and_rendering.challenge: Content loaded dynamically via JavaScript in Single Page Applications (SPAs) is often invisible to basic AI crawlers
javascript_and_rendering.impact: If AI bots can't see content in initial HTML, it won't appear in answer engines

solutions.description: Generate HTML on server before sending to browser
solutions.benefit: Content immediately visible in HTML source for all crawlers

solutions.description: Pre-build all pages as static HTML at build time
solutions.limitation: Best for content that doesn't change frequently

solutions.description: Serve static HTML to bots, full JavaScript to users
solutions.implementation: Detect user-agent and serve appropriate version
solutions.benefit: Maintains rich user experience while ensuring bot access
solutions.caution: Google discourages but allows if done properly

solutions.description: Embed critical content in HTML, enhance with JavaScript
solutions.implementation: Start with semantic HTML, layer JavaScript functionality on top
solutions.benefit: Works for all users and crawlers regardless of JavaScript support

page_experience_core_web_vitals.definition: User experience metrics that influence both SEO rankings and crawler efficiency

components.measures: Loading performance - time until largest content element visible
components.aeo_impact: Slow loading may cause crawlers to timeout before rendering content

components.metric: First Input Delay (FID) / Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
components.aeo_impact: Less direct impact but contributes to overall page quality signals

optimization_tactics: Optimize images (WebP format, proper sizing, lazy loading)

mobile_optimization.importance: Mobile-first indexing means Google primarily uses mobile version for ranking and AI answer selection
requirements: Responsive design that adapts to all screen sizes
Touch-friendly interface with adequate button/link spacing
Fast mobile load times (target under 3 seconds)
No intrusive interstitials or pop-ups on mobile
mobile_optimization.testing: Use Google Mobile-Friendly Test and Search Console Mobile Usability report
mobile_optimization.aeo_impact: Many AI queries originate from mobile devices; poor mobile experience reduces citation likelihood

security_https.requirement: HTTPS (SSL/TLS encryption) is mandatory for modern SEO and AEO
impacts: Required for many modern web features
security_https.implementation: Obtain SSL certificate, configure server, update all internal links to HTTPS, set up 301 redirects from HTTP

modern_crawler_capabilities.javascript_rendering: Modern crawlers like Firecrawl can render JavaScript and SPAs, but basic bots cannot
modern_crawler_capabilities.anti_blocking: Advanced crawlers use stealth mode and proxy rotation to avoid detection
content_extraction_formats: Markdown - Clean, structured text (preferred by many AI systems)
modern_crawler_capabilities.actions_before_scraping: Can click elements, scroll, fill forms before capturing content
modern_crawler_capabilities.source: Synthesis of the public Firecrawl documentation

selector_strategies: CSS selectors - Simple, readable syntax for element selection
XPath - Powerful querying for complex extraction patterns
scrapy_framework_insights.spider_architecture: Different spider types for different content structures (recursive crawling, XML feeds, CSV, sitemaps)
scrapy_framework_insights.robots_txt_compliance: Built-in respect for crawl rules and delays
scrapy_framework_insights.source: Synthesis of the public Scrapy documentation

crawler_friendly_design_principles.rationale: SSR ensures all content visible in initial HTML, accessible to all crawlers regardless of JavaScript capability
crawler_friendly_design_principles.implementation: Use Next.js, Nuxt.js, or similar SSR frameworks for dynamic content

crawler_friendly_design_principles.rationale: Semantic HTML (header, nav, main, article, section, footer) helps crawlers understand content hierarchy
crawler_friendly_design_principles.implementation: Use HTML5 semantic elements, proper heading hierarchy (H1-H6), meaningful class names

crawler_friendly_design_principles.rationale: JSON-LD structured data explicitly defines content meaning for crawlers
crawler_friendly_design_principles.implementation: Implement comprehensive schema types relevant to content (Article, Product, FAQPage, HowTo, Organization)
Use Static Site Generation (SSG) for important landing pages, product pages, and content hubs

crawler_friendly_design_principles.rationale: Crawlers have timeout limits; slow pages may not fully render
crawler_friendly_design_principles.implementation: Optimize images, minimize JavaScript, use CDN, improve server response times

crawler_friendly_design_principles.rationale: Content behind login barriers is invisible to public crawlers
crawler_friendly_design_principles.implementation: Create public summaries or previews of gated content, use schema to indicate free vs. paid content

crawler_friendly_design_principles.rationale: Clear URL patterns and comprehensive sitemaps enable complete site discovery
crawler_friendly_design_principles.implementation: Logical URL hierarchy, XML sitemaps with all important pages, pattern-based URL structure

crawler_friendly_design_principles.rationale: Explicitly permit AI crawlers to ensure content access
crawler_friendly_design_principles.implementation: Allow ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, GoogleOther, Google-Extended in robots.txt

content_extraction_optimization.description: Structure content in a way that converts cleanly to Markdown
best_practices: Use clear heading hierarchy (H1, H2, H3)
Employ bulleted and numbered lists liberally
Use emphasis (bold, italic) sparingly and meaningfully
Structure tables with proper thead and tbody elements
content_extraction_optimization.rationale: Many AI systems prefer Markdown for clean text extraction

content_extraction_optimization.description: Use semantic, consistent class and ID naming
best_practices: Consistent class naming conventions (e.g., BEM methodology)
Meaningful, descriptive class names (avoid generic 'div1', 'content-box')
Use data attributes for semantic metadata
Avoid deeply nested element structures
content_extraction_optimization.rationale: Easier for scrapers to target and extract specific content sections

content_extraction_optimization.description: Avoid unnecessarily complex or obfuscated markup
best_practices: Keep JavaScript bundles readable (avoid excessive minification for critical content)
Use standard HTML elements over custom web components when possible
Avoid canvas or WebAssembly for text content
Provide text alternatives for visual content
content_extraction_optimization.rationale: Complex rendering chains reduce crawler success rate

technical_challenges_and_solutions.crawler_limitation: Basic bots see empty initial HTML
technical_challenges_and_solutions.solution: Server-Side Rendering or Static Site Generation
Create public preview pages, use schema to indicate locked content, externalize key context

technical_challenges_and_solutions.crawler_limitation: CAPTCHAs and multi-step flows prevent bot interaction
technical_challenges_and_solutions.solution: Create static result pages, use schema markup for form-generated data, externalize form logic

technical_challenges_and_solutions.crawler_limitation: Text/graphics drawn on canvas invisible to bots
technical_challenges_and_solutions.solution: Provide fallback text content, use ARIA labels, parallel textual content

technical_challenges_and_solutions.crawler_limitation: Wasm code doesn't reflect in DOM
technical_challenges_and_solutions.solution: Implement DOM reflection, use hidden elements with text content, create JSON-LD schemas
